value_date.title: value_date
value_date.description: Settlement date of the FX transaction (yyyy-MM-dd, not required for Instant FX transactions).

expiry_time.title: expiry_time
expiry_time.description: The expiration timestamp of the quote. If the transaction is not executed, the `fx_rate_id` will expire after the date and time. After the expiration timestamp, you should request new fx_rate format : YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ).

Created-Time.description: Date and time of the file created. Pattern YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ
Created-Time.title: created_time

Currency-Code.title: currency_code
Currency-Code.description: The currency code in the transaction.

Fx-Rate.title: fx_rate
Fx-Rate.description: The indicative FX rate which is for reference only. The number indicates how much units of buy_currency you can get from one unit of sell_currency.

Fx-Rate-Id.title: fx_rate_id
Fx-Rate-Id.description: When you request a guaranteed quote of Instant FX and Reserved FX, the Citi will return a `fx_rate_id`, which is the unique ID only for guaranteed `fx_indi_rate. <b> fx_rate_id is mandatory for other than USD to USD transfer.

buy_currency_code.title: buy_currency_code
buy_currency_code.description: The currency that the client is buying.

buy_amount.title: buy_amount
buy_amount.description: The amount of buy_currency for the transaction. (You ONLY need to define one amount, either buy_amount or sell_amount in a request.)

sell_currency_code.title: sell_currency_code
sell_currency_code.description: The currency that the client is selling.

sell_amount.title: sell_amount
sell_amount.description: The amount of sell_currency for the transaction. (You ONLY need to define one amount, either buy_amount or sell_amount in a request.)

Reference-Id.title: reference_id
Reference-Id.description: Unique identifier for this request from your system.
